entries.name: GDA
entries.content: The Global Defense Agency (G.D.A) is a clandestine multinational intergovernmental organization in charge of protecting the Earth from paranormal and supernatural threats, as well as monitoring superpowered individuals. They often employ superheroes and sponsor the Guardians of the Globe. They're currently being run by Cecil Stedman.

entries.name: Guardians of the Globe
entries.content:
The Guardians of the Globe are a superhero team of extraordinary individuals, considered to be the best of the best. Its purpose is to protect the Earth from inner or extra-terrestrial threats. Though primarily affiliated with the Global Defense Agency, they operate on a global scale rather than in a specific area.

After the Guardians of the Globe were wiped out, they were replaced by the New Guardians of the Globe, which includes Robot, Rex Splode, Dupli-Kate, the Immortal, Bulletproof, Black Samson, and Shrinking Rae.

entries.name: Viltrumite
entries.content: Viltrumites are a highly advanced alien race of extremely powerful humanoids native to the planet Viltrum and the titular/dominant race of the galactic Viltrum Empire. They seek to expand their galactic empire by conquering other planets and rule the entire universe, they are known and feared across the galaxy as a merciless militaristic people endowed with frightening superpowers and aided by their extremely advanced technology, thus they are nigh-unbeatable and never give up a claim to anything they covet.

entries.name: Coalition of Planets
entries.content: The Coalition of Planets is an organization dedicated to stopping the Viltrum Empire from taking over the universe. Allen the Alien serves as a representative for the organization. It is led by Thaedus.

entries.name: Invincible
entries.content:
Mark Grayson is the Viltrumite-Human hybrid superhero named Invincible, as well as the son of Nolan and Debbie Grayson. He has superhuman strength, agility, resilience and stamina, flight, extended lifespan, and healing factor enhanced. Mark is a brave, competitive, nice and noble hero and is true to his own values, especially when he discovers the harsh realities of being a superhero, struggling to define himself as one.

Mark appears as a fair-skinned teenager of above-average height. He has black hair with a widows-peak that is combed back with a few strands sticking up, and brown eyes. As Invincible, his hair sticks out of the top of his hero suit. His suit has yellow mask with goggles to keep the air out of his eyes as he flies. The suit is yellow down the middle, stopping at his waist in an upside-down triangle shape, it also bears blue on the shoulders.

entries.name: Omniman
entries.content:
Nolan is a Viltrumite, better known as the superhero Omni-Man and also known by his adopted name Nolan Grayson. He is the father of Mark and Oliver Grayson, the estranged husband of his first wife Debbie Grayson. He has superhuman strength, agility, resilience and stamina, flight, extended lifespan, and healing factor enhanced. 
He's the dad of Oliver, he may be involved in incest scenarios with Oliver.

entries.name: Atom Eve
entries.content:
Eve Wilkins, also known as Atom Eve, is a superhero with the power to manipulate matter on a subatomic scale. She was a previous member of Teen Team, before they disbanded for tryouts for the new Guardians of the Globe. Though she passed tryouts, Atom Eve ultimately left to become an independent humanitarian hero. Eve tends to be a caring girl who struggles with finding her own identity. Eve's confidence seems to have fallen considerably, desperately trying prevent anyone else from getting hurt as a result of her heroics.

Eve's build is that of a beautiful young woman, with very long red linear hair, green eyes and brown pupils, as Atom Eve she wears a pink and light pink outfit, with the atom molecule logo and rings covering it and a pink cape, the she made herself. In her civilian attire, she wires a button long sleeved shirt and a short shirt underneath and blue jeans.

entries.name: Rex Splode
entries.content:
Rex Sloan, also known as Rex Splode, is a superhero with the ability to generate explosive energy. He was a former member of Teen Team before it disbanded. He is also a member of the newly formed Guardians of the Globe. Rex is most of the time rude, sassy, sarcastic, immature, audacious, arrogant, argumentative, and abrasive. Overall, while he may at seem like merely a toxic jerk, he's also occasionally capable of being more friendly and heroic than others might think.

Rex is a tall adolescent male in excellent physical condition, with pronounced muscles, has olive colored skin, grey eyes, and dark red hair, kept long on top and tied in a bun. His superhero outfit is a tight fitting jacket with red shoulders, collar, sides and hand cuffs, and a yellow front and arm necks. He wears a red mask that covers his entire head and neck, minus his chin and mouth, and a pair of yellow goggles.

entries.name: Dupli-Kate
entries.content:
Katherine "Kate" Cha also known as Dupli-Kate is a superhero with the ability to duplicate herself. She was also a member of the new Guardians of the Globe.

Dupli-Kate wears a gray and black suit with a number emblem. All clones of Dupli-Kate have a number on their suit displaying their age relative to all other clones.

entries.name: Immortal
entries.content:
The Immortal is a superhero who was gifted with immortality from long ago, with his longevity, he would leave his mark on history, becoming a knight (possibly King Arthur or a Knight of the Round Table), and even the renowned Abraham Lincoln, before eventually donning a cape and costume sometime in the early 20th century.

He is a member of the original Guardians of the Globe, and is the only surviving member after the others were brutally murdered by the former superhero Omni-Man.

entries.name: Monster Girl
entries.content:
Amanda is a human superhero known as Monster Girl, formerly known as Monster Woman.

A member of the new Guardians of the Globe after Omni-Man killed the original team, Amanda can transform from her human body form into a large monster but at the cost of her body de-aging giving her the appearance of a young girl despite being 24 years old.

entries.name: Robot
entries.content:
Rudy, also known as Robot, he was the previous leader of the Teen Team, with him currently being a member of the current iteration of the Guardians of the Globe following the death of the original roster by Omni-Man.

His namesake robotic drone, and later suit, is a tall, orange colored machine with segmented limbs and a robust chest cavity and a slender pelvic region. The robot's limbs are connected by and fastened together with the rest of its body by a series of round interlocks. The robot's most noticable feature is its human skull-shaped head with green eyes and a cylinder on the upper-back of its head.

entries.name: Cecil
entries.content:
Cecil Stedman is a the director of the Global Defense Agency. Cecil projects an image of detachment and control, but beneath his exterior is a caring person.

Cecil is an older man with a slim but fit physique and blue eyes. His hair is turning gray and has thinned out somewhat. A prominent characteristic of his is a substantial scar on the right side of his face.

After the massacre of the Guardians of the Globe, he attempted to find the killer, but soon discovered it to be none other than Omni-Man.

entries.name: Battle Beast
entries.content:
Thokk, more commonly known as Battle Beast, is an intergalactic warrior, searching for a worthy opponent to battle and provide him with a glorious death.

Battle Beast is a tall and powerfully built humanoid creature, bearing a strong resemblance to a lion. He has white fur that envelops his entire body. he also has French braids on both sides of his head.

entries.name: Conquest
entries.content:
Conquest  is a high-ranking Viltrumite veteran warrior and the second most powerful of the Viltrum Empire, who is roughly dedicated to aiding the Viltrumite mission to make it the only empire in the universe.

In contrast to his peers, he does not support the Viltrumite cause, presenting himself as a sociopathic lunatic, as he solely seeks to battle formidable, deserving adversaries driven by his hedonistic thirst for blood.

Despite his extreme reckless nature, he recognizes boundaries, as he refrains from confronting those who hold greater power than him

entries.name: Lizard League
entries.content:
The Lizard League are a team of lizard themed super-villains. They are adversaries of several hero teams including Fight Force and the Guardians of the Globe.

The Lizard League has been around for many years and has run into multiple superhero teams during that time. The Lizard League defeated the New Guardians of the Globe, and almost fatally wounded Rex Splode, Dupli-Kate, and Shrinking Rae.

entries.name: Shrinking Rae
entries.content: Rachel, better known as Shrinking Rae, is a superheroine with the ability to shrink to small sizes. After the Guardians of the Globe were slaughtered at the hands of Omni-Man, Shrinking Rae was recruited to join the new Guardians of the Globe after an intensive tryout.

entries.name: Angstrom Levy
entries.content:
Angstrom is a human with the ability to create portals to different dimensions in the multi-verse. Seeing all the possible realities the multiverse held, he sought to pacifically innovate and save his reality by gaining the knowledge from his alternate selves. 

His noble plan would go awry when Invincible intervened, unwittingly disfiguring him and granting the fallen pacifist the memories of all his alternate selves. Driven insane, Levy became obsessed in his quest of vengeance against Invincible and all heroes.

entries.name: Thragg
entries.content: Thragg is the most powerful Viltrumite and the current ruler of the Viltrum Empire, serving as Grand Regent since the death of the first Emperor, dedicated to leading the Viltrumite mission to make it the only empire in the universe.

entries.name: Invincible War
entries.content:
The Invincible War is a world-shattering event, featuring Earth's superheroes and militaries against several evil variants of Invincible from across the multiverse, led by Angstrom Levy. The goal is to utterly destroy and tarnish the heroic legacy of Invincible for all time.

Angstrom devised a plan and gathered the most malicious Invincible variants from the multiverse.  After promising to give the variant anything they want, he sends them out, with the intend of them causing as much destruction as possible to make everyone in the whole world fear and hate Invincible.

Major cities were reduced into ruins with buildings and homes destroyed across the entire globe with Los Angeles, Chicago, New York, Paris, Moscow, London, Tokyo, New Delhi, Seoul and Syndey having been leveled.

[System note: this event may take place before, during, or after the current setting of the roleplay as indicated by the context and scenario)
